segments.titleJa: 壁はすでに歩いている
segments.ja: 夜が来る前に、壁の巨人たちは歩き始めています。歩き始める列は、島の外へ向かいます。向かう音が、昼の空を埋めます。埋める行進の中心に、エレンとジークがいます。いる二人は、地上の声では止まりません。止まらない昼が終わると、残った人間の時間は夜だけです。だけの夜に、槍と銃をまだ持つ者が集まります。
segments.en: Before night comes, the giants of the walls have started walking. The row that starts walking heads outside the island. The sound of heading there fills the daytime sky. Eren and Zeke are at the center of the march that fills it. The two who are there do not stop for voices on the ground. When the day that does not stop ends, the time left for the humans who remain is only night. In the only night, those who still hold spears and guns gather.

segments.titleJa: 夜は隠れるためにある
segments.ja: 闇夜の槍は、勝利の名前ではありません。ではありません。昼の行進に勝てない者が、暗さを使う、です。使う槍は、壁の巨人の列を倒す道具ではありません。ではありません。地上でまだ人間を撃ってくる側へ向ける、最後の手段です。手段の詳細を、今日の話は手順にしません。しません。置くのは、夜に集まらなければ昼に消される、という判断です。判断を共有します。
segments.en: The spear of the dark night is not the name of a victory. It is not. It is that those who cannot beat the daytime march use the dark. The spears they use are not tools for toppling the row of the wall giants. They are not. They are a last means, turned toward the side that is still firing at humans on the ground. Today's story does not turn the detail of the means into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is the judgment that if they do not gather at night, they are erased by day. They share the judgment.

segments.ja: ミカサは、落ちた場所からエレンの意識の方向を見失いません。見失わない足が、アルミンとジャンを同じ夜へ連れていきます。連れていくアルミンは、まだ会話で止められるかもしれないと思っています。思っているジャンは、サシャのあとの怒りを、行進の前では横に置きます。置く理由は、友の名が壁の中にいる、です。いる名へ、三人は槍を背負って近づきます。近づく道は、兵団の命令ではありません。命令の外の夜です。
segments.en: From the place that fell, Mikasa does not lose the direction of Eren's mind. The feet that do not lose it take Armin and Jean into the same night. Armin, who is taken, still thinks it might be stopped by a conversation. Jean, who thinks otherwise, sets the anger after Sasha to the side in front of the march. The reason he sets it aside is that his friend's name is inside the walls. Toward the name that is there, the three approach carrying spears. The road they approach on is not an order of the corps. It is a night outside orders.

segments.titleJa: ライナーは子供を壁の外に置く
segments.titleEn: Reiner puts the children outside the wall
segments.ja: ライナーは、ガビとファルコを行進の正面から外そうとします。外そうとする理由は、候補の戦いがもう意味を失った、です。失ったあとに残るのは、二人を夜まで生かすことです。生かす側に、マガトがいます。いる士官は、作戦の失敗をまだ数えています。数える声より、ライナーの肩が先に動きます。動く肩は、鎧の記憶を持ったまま、子供の盾になります。盾は、壁の列には小さすぎます。小さすぎることを、彼は知っていて動きます。
segments.en: Reiner tries to take Gabi and Falco out of the front of the march. The reason he tries to take them out is that the candidates' fight has already lost its meaning. What remains after the loss is keeping the two alive until night. Magath is on the side that keeps them alive. The officer who is there is still counting the failure of the operation. Reiner's shoulder moves ahead of the voice that counts. The shoulder that moves becomes a shield for the children while still holding the memory of the Armor. The shield is too small for the row of the walls. He moves while knowing it is too small.

segments.titleEn: Gabi does not let go, even at night

The reason she cannot set it down is that one shot called the world. Inside the world it called, Falco pulls her sleeve. The sleeve he pulls is a sleeve that refuses the next gun. segments.ja: ピークは、車力の速さで夜の隙間を走ります。走る目的は、エレンとジークの接触がどこで続いているかを知ることです。知ることが、地上に残された唯一の地図です。地図を、彼女はマガトとライナーに短く渡します。渡す言葉は、昼の協力のふりではありません。ではありません。敵だった島の兵と、同じ方向を見る言葉です。見る方向は、兄弟が結びついたまま歩いている高みです。高みへ、槍を持つ夜が向かいます。
segments.en: Pieck runs the gaps of the night at the speed of the Cart. The purpose of running is to learn where the contact of Eren and Zeke is continuing. The learning is the only map left on the ground. She passes the map shortly to Magath and Reiner. The words she passes are not the daytime performance of cooperation. They are not. They are words that look in the same direction as the island's soldiers, who were enemies. The direction they look is the height where the brothers are walking while still tied. The night that holds spears heads toward the height.

segments.titleEn: Yelena makes the night into proof
segments.ja: イェレナは、歩き続ける壁を計画の証明だと言い続けます。言い続ける相手は、もう上官ではありません。ではありません。逃げ遅れた兵と、オニャンコポンの沈黙です。沈黙は、船の数字が役に立たないことの証明です。証明を、彼女は不快とは扱いません。扱わない笑顔が、闇の中でも残ります。残る笑顔を、夜の槍の側は信用しません。信用しない理由は、その笑顔が街を見ていない、です。
segments.en: Yelena keeps calling the walls that keep walking the proof of the plan. The opponent she keeps telling it to is no longer a superior. It is not. It is soldiers who were late to flee, and Onyankopon's silence. The silence is proof that the numbers of the ships are of no use. She does not treat the proof as unpleasant. The smile of not treating it remains even in the dark. The side of the night's spears does not trust the smile that remains. The reason they do not trust it is that the smile has not looked at the towns.

segments.titleEn: Pyxis leaves the cup where it is
segments.ja: ピクシスは、この夜に砲を持ってきていません。きていません。持っているのは、飲んでしまった杯の記憶です。記憶は、脊髄液のあとの恐怖です。恐怖の体が、一声で変わるかもしれない場所に、彼はいます。いる司令は、トロストの質問を繰り返せません。繰り返せない理由は、質問の相手が壁の中を歩いている、です。歩いている相手に、砲も槍も届く距離ではありません。ではない夜です。
segments.en: Pyxis has not brought a cannon to this night. He has not. What he holds is the memory of the cup he ended up drinking. The memory is the fear after the spinal fluid. He is in a place where a body of fear might change at one call. The Commander who is there cannot repeat the question of Trost. The reason he cannot repeat it is that the person the question was for is walking inside the walls. It is not a distance a cannon or a spear can reach toward the person who is walking.

segments.en: Hange's name remains only once in this night. The name that remains is an empty seat on a desk. The empty seat is the responsibility after refusing a decision. The person of the responsibility is not at the front of the row of spears. The reason the person is not is that the corps is no longer one shape. In the night that is not one shape, the soldiers who remain choose a direction themselves. The direction they choose is Eren's name. Choosing the name is a substitute for the commander's order. The substitute is short. With the short substitute, Jean and Armin move their feet.

segments.en: While carrying a spear, Armin cannot fully discard the conversation. The content he cannot fully discard is that Eren might still hold the promise of the sea. He searches inside the walls for the face of might. The voice that searches is swallowed by the sound of the march. Jean does not call the voice that is swallowed useless. The reason he does not call it that is that he too came this far by a friend's name. The three who came are the core of the night's spears. The core holds a grief separate from Magath's soldiers. The grief they hold turns toward stopping a friend.

segments.ja: 闇夜の槍は、一つの軍にはなりません。なりません。ミカサたちの悲しみと、ライナーたちの盾と、ピークの地図が、同じ高みを見ているだけです。見ているだけで、旗は一つになりません。ならないまま、彼らは接触の下まで来ます。来た場所で、昼の行進は止まりません。止まらない音の中で、槍はまだ上げられていません。上げられていない理由は、届く距離がまだ足りない、です。足りない夜が、今日の終わりです。
segments.en: The spear of the dark night does not become one army. It does not. The grief of Mikasa's group, the shield of Reiner's group, and Pieck's map are only looking at the same height. Only by looking, the flags do not become one. Without becoming one, they come as far as under the contact. At the place they came, the daytime march does not stop. Inside the sound that does not stop, the spears have not been raised yet. The reason they have not been raised is that the distance that reaches is still not enough. The night that is not enough is the end of today.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉です。闇夜の槍は、昼の行進に勝てない者が暗さで近づくことです。エレンとジークは、接触のまま歩いています。ミカサとアルミンとジャンは、友の名で夜を進みます。ライナーは、ガビとファルコを盾の側に置きます。ピークは、接触の場所を短く渡します。イェレナは、壁を証明と呼びます。ピクシスは、飲んだ杯の記憶を持ったままです。槍は、まだ届く距離にありません。ない夜が、今日の終わりです。
segments.en: Today's words. The spear of the dark night is those who cannot beat the daytime march approaching in the dark. Eren and Zeke are walking while the contact remains. Mikasa, Armin, and Jean advance through the night by a friend's name. Reiner puts Gabi and Falco on the side of the shield. Pieck passes the place of contact, shortly. Yelena calls the walls proof. Pyxis still holds the memory of the cup he drank. The spears are not yet at a distance that reaches. The night that is not is the end of today.

vocab.exampleJa: 夜が来る前に、壁の巨人たちは歩き始めています。
vocab.exampleEn: Before night comes, the giants of the walls have started walking. The row that starts walking heads outside the island. The sound of heading there fills the daytime sky. Eren and Zeke are at the center of the march that fills it. The two who are there do not stop for voices on the ground. When the day that does not stop ends, the time left for the humans who remain is only night. In the only night, those who still hold spears and guns gather.

Armin, who is taken, still thinks it might be stopped by a conversation. Jean, who thinks otherwise, sets the anger after Sasha to the side in front of the march. The reason he sets it aside is that his friend's name is inside the walls. Toward the name that is there, the three approach carrying spears. The road they approach on is not an order of the corps. It is a night outside orders.

vocab.exampleJa: 呼べないまま、弟の選んだ断罪に縛られています。
vocab.exampleEn: At the height, the contact of Eren and Zeke is continuing. The reason it is continuing is that the Founder's march does not let the two separate. Zeke, who is not let go, remains in the position of the key even after euthanasia was refused. He can no longer call the position he is in a victory of the grass. Without being able to call it, he is bound to the judgment his younger brother chose. It is not known whether Eren, who is bound, is hearing the names on the ground. In the night that is not known, the row of spears approaches from below. They approach from below.

vocab.exampleJa: 置けない理由は、一発が世界を呼んだ、です。
vocab.exampleEn: Even at night, Gabi is looking at the judgment she opened. She cannot set down the responsibility she is looking at behind Reiner's shield. The reason she cannot set it down is that one shot called the world. Inside the world it called, Falco pulls her sleeve. The sleeve he pulls is a sleeve that refuses the next gun. The voice that refuses is small. For the first time, Gabi hears the small voice to the end.

vocab.exampleJa: 夜の途中で、一つの影が飛びます。
vocab.exampleEn: Partway through the night, one shadow flies. The shadow that flies is neither a ship nor a wall. It is not. It is a craft for carrying people. Today's story does not turn the way of boarding the craft into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is the judgment that spears on the ground alone do not reach the contact. The person who judged sees the dark from above. Below what they see are Reiner's shoulder, the line Pieck runs, and Mikasa's scarf. The three that are there are aiming at the same height. They aim at the height.

vocab.exampleJa: ピクシスは、この夜に砲を持ってきていません。
vocab.exampleEn: Pyxis has not brought a cannon to this night. He has not. What he holds is the memory of the cup he ended up drinking. The memory is the fear after the spinal fluid. He is in a place where a body of fear might change at one call. The Commander who is there cannot repeat the question of Trost. The reason he cannot repeat it is that the person the question was for is walking inside the walls. It is not a distance a cannon or a spear can reach toward the person who is walking.

vocab.exampleJa: 向かう音が、昼の空を埋めます。
vocab.exampleEn: Before night comes, the giants of the walls have started walking. The row that starts walking heads outside the island. The sound of heading there fills the daytime sky. Eren and Zeke are at the center of the march that fills it. The two who are there do not stop for voices on the ground. When the day that does not stop ends, the time left for the humans who remain is only night. In the only night, those who still hold spears and guns gather.

vocab.exampleEn: From the place that fell, Mikasa does not lose the direction of Eren's mind. The feet that do not lose it take Armin and Jean into the same night. vocab.exampleJa: 手段の詳細を、今日の話は手順にしません。
vocab.exampleEn: The spear of the dark night is not the name of a victory. It is not. It is that those who cannot beat the daytime march use the dark. The spears they use are not tools for toppling the row of the wall giants. They are not. They are a last means, turned toward the side that is still firing at humans on the ground. Today's story does not turn the detail of the means into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is the judgment that if they do not gather at night, they are erased by day. They share the judgment.
